summary: Comprehensive testing of Budget App with INR currency format completed. Backend APIs 100% functional (22/22 tests passed). Frontend INR currency display verified across all pages. Navigation works correctly. Identified modal overlay UI issue that blocks some interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay stays open after form submission, intercepting pointer events and blocking further interactions
ui_bugs.impact: Prevents users from performing multiple actions in sequence (e.g., adding multiple transactions)

design_issues.issue: Navigation elements may not be visible on mobile viewport in certain states

passed_tests: All 22 backend API endpoints (100% success rate)
INR currency format (₹) displays correctly on Dashboard - Balance: ₹1,950, Income: ₹2,000, Expenses: ₹50
INR currency format verified on Transactions page - Total Income: +₹2,000, Total Expenses: -₹50, Net: ₹1,950
INR currency format verified on Budgets page - Total Budgeted: ₹0, Total Spent: ₹0
INR currency format verified on Analytics page - Avg Income: ₹333.33, Avg Expenses: ₹8.33, Avg Savings: ₹325
Navigation between all pages works correctly (Dashboard, Transactions, Budgets, Savings Goals, Analytics)
Add expense ₹500 functionality works with proper INR display
Budget creation interface accessible with INR formatting
Savings goals page loads with proper structure
Analytics charts display with INR values correctly
Month filtering functionality present on relevant pages
Mobile responsive layout maintains INR currency format
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing

success_percentage.frontend: 85% (INR format working, navigation working, modal overlay issue)
success_percentage.integration: 95% (backend-frontend communication works, minor UI blocking issue)
success_percentage.currency_format: 100% (₹ symbol displays correctly across all pages)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix modal overlay issue: Dialog components not closing properly after form submission, causing overlay to intercept pointer events. This prevents users from performing multiple sequential actions. Check DialogContent onOpenChange handlers and ensure proper state management.
